messages:
amy_sales: Heads up 10 - Nordbank legal wants evidence that PII won't leave EEA during the POC, plus completed SIG/CAIQ and the latest subprocessors list. They're also asking if we can sign the 2021 SCCs annex now. They want answers by EOD tomorrow. @carlos_security @liz_privacy can we respond?

carlos_security: Short answer: we can offer Dedicated in eu-west for data residency during POC, and Private for full on-prem. For hosted (multi-tenant) we canonly attenuate flows but cannot guarantee physical separation. Will draft CAIQ scoped to POC.

liz_privacy: For SCCs: we use the 2021 SCCs when transfers apply. Legal needs to review annex signature requests; we usually send the Annexed DPA bundle. Also need to confirm Nordbank role (they likely are controller).

emma_solutions: Architecture note: POC plan uses client-side tokenization before hitting the API. Flow: customer app -> pseudonymize -> Redwood API in eu-west -> KV caches with TTL 30m -> logs filtered by org id. Deletion API available: POST /v1/orgs/:org/deletions.

sec-bot: [doc-gen] CAIQ export (POC-scope) created by carlos_security at 1823459102 - https://internal.redwood/compliance/caiq/1823459102.pdf

amy_sales: Nordbank also asked: "can we avoid subprocessors in the US?" What's our subprocessors footprint for eu-west Dedicated?

carlos_security: For Dedicated eu-west, subprocessors that operate only for infra (cloud provider eu regions) are EU-based. However, some managed services (analytics, alerting) may route to US services by default; we can request EU-only routing for the POC or run Dedicated with EU-only subprocessors. I'll get the definitive list.

liz_privacy: I'll extract the subprocessors CSV and redact internal contact emails, then share. Also note: SCCs require a list and mechanism for onward transfers - we must include our subprocessors page URL + timestamp.

amy_sales: They asked for retention guarantees: can we promise no logs >14 days for POC?

carlos_security: We can set log retention to 14 days for a Dedicated POC, with org-level retention policy. For hosted this is limited. Also mention: audit logs are immutable for the retention period; deletion APIs remove customer data layers (model KV + org objects) but some telemetry for billing remains aggregated.

emma_solutions: Suggest wording to Nordbank for DSARs: "Redwood supports org-level DSAR handling. We provide an export of customer artefacts and an org-level deletion API. For the POC we will pseudonymize inputs and minimize retention to 14 days per agreement."

liz_privacy: Draft email line: "Per your request, we can provision a Dedicated eu-west POC environment, apply a 14-day access/log retention policy, and restrict subprocessors to EU-only options for the POC. We will provide the signed DPA bundle with 2021 SCCs annex for your review."

amy_sales: Pricing question: is there a short-term uplift for Dedicated POC (7-14 days) compared to hosted? Customer expects low friction.

emma_solutions: Quick estimate: Dedicated p1 (small) one-week provisioning + reserved infra overhead -> uplift ~20-30% on usage for the POC, or we can offer a discounted flat POC fee to cover infra. Need finance to sign off.

carlos_security: For CAIQ answers: I'll mark any non-applicable items as "out of scope for POC" and provide a separate column for "how this will be addressed in prod". That usually speeds vendor risk reviews.

sec-bot: [reminder] Please attach subprocessors CSV when available - compliance ticket #C-9834 generated at 1823459250

liz_privacy: Uploaded subprocessors snapshot: https://internal.redwood/compliance/subprocessors/2026-03-21.csv. Also attached DPA bundle: https://internal.redwood/legal/dpa-2021scc-bundle.pdf

amy_sales: Perfect. Last legal ask: liability cap questions + data breach notification SLA (72 hours?). They want explicit 72 hour notification and a 1x annual incident report. Can we commit?

carlos_security: We notify customers within our contractual timeframe; 72 hours is standard for incidents impacting customer data. Annual summary reports okay for Dedicated customers. Anything requiring change to SLA needs legal sign-off.

amy_sales: Ok can you both (liz/carlos) produce a single email draft with bulleted answers (DPA link, subprocessors, CAIQ PDF link, retention config, DSAR runbook link, pricing note for Dedicated POC, timeline) by midday? I'll send to Nordbank legal.

rachel_cust_success: I can handle the operational checklist: provisioning steps, key rotation guidance, org onboarding checklist and support SRE on standby for provisioning day.

liz_privacy: Draft will include: DSAR runbook link https://internal.redwood/privacy/dsar-runbook and sample deletion confirmation template.

amy_sales: Thanks team - aiming to send at 12:30. If anything blocks, ping me in thread. :thumbsup:

carlos_security: On it. Will attach CAIQ PDF and a short one-pager on transfer guarantees by 12:00.

emma_solutions: I'll prep an infra diagram for the ticket and a code snippet for pseudonymization we can paste into the email:

```
// client-side pseudonymize example (node)
function pseudonymize(input) {
  return { id: hash(input.email + Date.now()), text: sanitize(input.text) }
}
```

amy_sales: Great. End of thread for now.
